breaking.member: UI icon markup and color styling
breaking.change: Removed <icon>, -og-cue and -og-secondary-tint without aliases. The reflected <og-icon> tag preserves the internal icon kind and exposes separate image and secondary parts.
breaking.fix: Write <og-icon cue="danger"> for a semantic cue, or set its icon attribute explicitly. Use og-icon::part(image) and og-icon::part(secondary) with standard color declarations for independent layer colors. Rename inline icon tags to og-icon too.
